# Universe24

> One line of whole-number arithmetic on a cubic lattice of Nodes, Rule3 in the law's flux form, read through clicks: the formulas it shares with nature and adds. A paper archived on Zenodo and at the tag v1.1.0, its supplement with every proof, the law of the lattice, the derivations as scripts, the engine of one Node with its tests and the paper's engine at the tag v1.1.0, and one world, Universe24: one Node, one universe file of three integers, the board a torus seeded with light, every family born at the click, the record read through the clicks by one decoder (examples/events/universe24/). Author: Alon Gonen, independent researcher, Haifa, Israel (ORCID 0009-0008-2701-4599). Licence MIT. Permanent record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466436 (the concept DOI of the releases from 3.0.0 on, resolving to the latest version; the versions 1.1.0 to 2.1.0 under https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23190113); the current software version, 4.0.0, Universe24: one Node, one universe: [the Zenodo DOI, minted at the release]; 3.0.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466437

## In plain words

Suppose nature is discrete: space is made of Nodes, and between one Node and the next nothing moves faster than light. A cubic centimetre then holds an astronomical number of Nodes, so no centre can know and decide for all of them; each Node acts on its own, by a rule of its own, seeing only itself and its six neighbours. Universe24 is that rule: one line of whole-number arithmetic with no free number but the universe's three integers, den, the Node clock and the whole piece's action. A Node holds, for every row of the universe, its level now, its level one interval before, and a remainder; at every interval it forms one sum, twice its level now less its level before at the wall, plus what crosses its six Links at each Link's reach, less its own mass term, zero for light, plus the carried remainder, and divides by the wall; the quotient is its next level and the new remainder is kept. Nothing is lost, so the rule is exactly reversible. The rule is on whole numbers of any size and carries no bound; the bound is the engine's, from the width of its integers, derived. The tick is the count of rounds and no Node reads it. The rows are derived from den: light, the holder of the volume and the holder of the sign, and one plane row per point of den's circle; the reach of a Link comes from the row's pair, the Node's paces and the Link's tension, the mass of a Node from the pair and the paces. A world that declares nothing is seeded with light at one quantum on every Node of the torus, and the board reads itself: where two whole quanta stand at a Node a pair of matter is born there, the Node's own read of itself and its six Links, one Link and one number, drawing the whether and picking the children among den's primes' lifts; the hole is the exact take, and a refusal is a logged line. A Node does not know families; they come out through the click, and one decoder names them from the clicks. The click is the one act with a direction; every other act is a bijection, and a Node at the top of its own time line turns, its two levels exchanged; what the board shows of a return is read from the record's clicks and named (docs/FURTHER_RESEARCH.md, first). The paper's one claim: the rule helps compute things in nature. Every number in the paper is reproduced by a script in the repository.

## Read first

- [The paper, 40 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/one_rule/Universe24_Paper.pdf): "Universe24: one simple rule, the formulas it shares with nature and adds" (Alon Gonen, 2026)
- [The supplement, Online Resource 1, 85 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/one_rule/Universe24_Supplement.pdf): the claims list and the algebraic steps of every derivation
- [The time paper, 22 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/spacetime_events/Universe24_Discrete_Spacetime_of_Events_Paper.pdf): "A discrete spacetime of events in whole numbers: why clocks slow, why nothing outruns light, and why time has a direction only where something was measured" (Alon Gonen, 2026), its source, run and checks in papers/spacetime_events/, built and run by its build.sh
- [README](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/README.md): the aim, the law in three paragraphs, the one universe file and the one world, how to run it, the pages, the six checks read from the clicks, the former courses by name, the words from the law

## The documents

- [The law of the lattice](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/ALGEBRA.md): one algebraic line per rule, every clause dated and the old kept by name, the one Node, the click's read of the board, the board reading itself, the families at the click, the volume holder and the swap at the top
- [The decisions in force](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/HIGHLIGHTS.md): the owner's words of 2026-10-24 one line each, and the day's structure in the law's own words with its dated clause by heading
- [Further research](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/FURTHER_RESEARCH.md): what does not match nature, by name, first; then the one world's open items with where to start; the former courses' items named and struck, their text kept in the file's history
- [Follow-up papers](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/FOLLOW_UP_PAPERS.md): the papers the project proposes next, from the careful to the bold, each with its one question, what the project has in the law's status words, and the run or derivation it needs
- [The engine](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/ENGINE.md): the words, the main loop and Rule3 in the law's flux form with the interval's acts, the files, the output, the gates, how to run a world, the known issues and the open items
- [Contributing](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/CONTRIBUTING.md): forks and pull requests, the ground rules, the checks, how to report an error or a failed reproduction
- [The claims map](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/CLAIMS.md): every theorem, identity and quantitative claim of the proofs' inventory as one row, its place, statement, ground, kind, verdict and the function that checks it, generated from the proofs inventory
- [Errata](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/ERRATA.md): the findings in the text and what was done about them, with the commits and the versions of record
- [What changed](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/CHANGELOG.md): one entry per version, 4.0.0 Universe24, one Node, one universe (the pushes of 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24, PUSH 1 to 36, by sha, grouped by theme, the branches' bullets below them), 3.0.0 the click as one act, the spin and the atom, 2.1.0 the step in the law's flux form, 2.0.0 the engine V2 against 1.1.0, the paper's engine

## The code

- [Repository on GitHub](https://github.com/Closer24/Universe24): the derivations as scripts (tools/derivations/), the implementation (src/event_universe/), the tests that prove the Node's law (tests/), the one world (examples/events/universe24/) with its logs and pages, the one decoder (tools/clicks_read.py with tools/look/captions.py), and the former courses' folders under examples/events/ as frozen records
- [Zenodo record](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466436): the concept DOI of the releases from 3.0.0 on, the permanent record and the one to cite, resolving to the latest version (the versions 1.1.0 to 2.1.0 under [10.5281/zenodo.23190113](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23190113)); the current software version, 4.0.0, Universe24: one Node, one universe, is the version record [the Zenodo DOI, minted at the release]; 3.0.0, the click as one act, the spin and the atom, is [10.5281/zenodo.23466437](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466437); the paper's engine, version 1.1.0, is 10.5281/zenodo.23202100
